name: Lyo.RateLimit.Redis
tagline: Redis-backed quotas with the same fixed, sliding, and token-bucket rules as the in-memory store.
description: AddRedisRateLimit replaces an in-memory IRateLimitService. Use it only when more than one host must share a quota. A missing Redis connection string fails registration instead of falling back to memory.
features: **Same three windows.** Fixed, sliding, and token bucket use one Lua script each.
**One key.** The hash tag is {policy:partition}, so a sliding window never touches two slots.
**Scripted clock.** Production passes Redis TIME. Tests pass unix milliseconds.
**Fail closed.** RedisException and RedisTimeoutException deny the call unless FailOpen is set. A failure does not write.
**DI.** AddRedisRateLimit, the connection-string overload, and AddRedisRateLimitFromConfiguration.
